ef54bfb43e766aad0759.en: 35 divided by 7 is 5, so one unit is 5 hens. Brown is 2 units, which is 10 hens.
ef54bfb43e766aad0759.id: 35 dibagi 7 adalah 5, jadi satu unit bernilai 5 ekor ayam. Yang cokelat 2 unit, yaitu 10 ekor ayam.

db1d39c76fb472ca6731.en: 48 divided by 8 is 6, so one unit is 6 litres. The water is 5 units, which is 30 litres.
db1d39c76fb472ca6731.id: 48 dibagi 8 adalah 6, jadi satu unit bernilai 6 liter. Airnya 5 unit, yaitu 30 liter.

8bf0dd7e89c6633e17c0.en: 90 divided by 10 is 9, so one unit is 9 pages. Lola has read 3 units, which is 27 pages.
8bf0dd7e89c6633e17c0.id: 90 dibagi 10 adalah 9, jadi satu unit bernilai 9 halaman. Lola sudah membaca 3 unit, yaitu 27 halaman.
